title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S10 E01 — Buried Secrets of Hitler
With word of an urgent lead, Josh jets to Poland to join in the opening of a secret Nazi tunnel system dug into a dormant volcano; Josh helps a local team tear away a stone wall built by the Germans in the last days of World War II.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S10 E02 — Buried Secrets of the Nazis
Josh Gates rafts into an abandoned tunnel system to chase art and treasure stolen by the Third Reich; the diary of a high-ranking SS officer leads to a search for tons of stolen gold; Josh searches for a buried Nazi Enigma machine.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S07 E04 — Mystery of Dead Mountain
Braving sub-zero conditions in Siberia, Josh Gates investigates the Dyatlov Pass incident, during which nine hikers died under suspicious circumstances in 1959.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S07 E05 — Siberia's Coldest Case
Josh Gates concludes his in-depth investigation of the Dyatlov Pass incident; taking on Dead Mountain's brutal conditions, Josh and two investigators retrace the last steps of the hikers; a big discovery could finally solve the mystery.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S12 E07 — Lost Tomb of the Viking King
Josh chases the treasure of legendary Viking Harald Bluetooth Gormsson; the discovery of a mysterious gold artifact sends Josh on a journey through Scandinavia and into remote northern European forests to uncover Bluetooth's tomb and fortune.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
Josh's Favorites: The Real Goonies Treasure
For the 40th Anniversary of The Goonies, Josh braves the Oregon coast to search for the real-life pirate treasure that inspired his all-time favorite movie.

Zak and the crew gain access to a palatial California estate where spectral nuns roam its halls and a dark, oppressive energy terrorizes the staff; the team quickly discovers this is a haunting unlike any other they've encountered.

title: Ghost Adventures

Zak and the crew find themselves in an eerie desert town to investigate a casino haunted by the spirit of a notorious bootlegger; the team and comedian Matt Rife confront the dark energy that lurks around every corner.

S01 E08 — Fog of War
With less than a quarter of the bluefin quota still available to catch, a change in weather forces captains to shift their strategy; Tyler quickly scores three big fish; Joe takes to the air, he spots a lone tuna, then races to find it at sea.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S20 E18 — Graveyard for the Lost
John risks capsizing while fishing with a slack tank; Jake hauls in a large sea; under pressure to get home for the arrival of Mandy's second child, Sig and Clark fish deeper than ever before as mechanical problems mount.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S11 E08 — High-Rise Hotel Battlefield
A slice of the Miami suburbs stands out for its style and history; a hotel in Lebanon carries the scars of a civil war; a pirate radio station gets a mixed reception.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S11 E01 — Hunt for the Nazi Gold Train
A Polish castle becomes entwined in the hunt for lost Nazi treasure, the heir of an American business tycoon gets caught in a web of controversy, and an Irish estate is embroiled in a fight for freedom.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S11 E02 — Schindler's Deception
A place of hope in the Czech Republic quietly perseveres in the age of Nazi tyranny; a Moroccan politician sides with the French; an eco-friendly paradise in the Amazon proves to be unsustainable.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E05 — The Nightmare Neighbor
Tizzy sparks an internet movement to end a woman's racially charged harassment of her neighbors; a parking lot guard is targeted by a driver; a disgruntled customer wrecks a GameStop.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E07 — Road Rage on the Underage
Tizzy investigates a driver who violently assaults a teenage boy riding a bike; a customer catches a brazen shoplifter, and a woman nearly runs over her boyfriend at a gas station.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E06 — The Bumper Sticker Brawl
Tizzy investigates an assault triggered by a bumper sticker; a judge dishes out justice for an attack on a fast food worker, and a couple of road rage incidents have Tizzy fired up.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E08 — Beverly Hills Banger
Tizzy investigates a frightening confrontation between a man and a pair of Beverly Hills reality show stars; a woman allegedly pepper sprays another driver for going too slowly, and a delivery person busts up a Taco Bell.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E01 — The Good, the Bad and the Unlucky
As the Golden Nugget's busiest season begins, tempers flare at check-in; a swiped $1,000 chip sparks a hotel-wide high-tech hunt; surveillance targets a team of card counters; and a VIP host gets creative to keep his client gambling.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E02 — Big Bang Theories
Reports of loud bangs and bullet holes on the eighth floor spark a tense night before the cause of the chaos is discovered one floor above.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E03 — Sex, Lies and Surveillance Tape
A hotel guest reports a theft that launches an investigation with security and Metro detectives, but the truth proves to be far more scandalous.

title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups
description:
S01 E03 — Weather Weapons
Are weather control fears fact, or just modern fiction?; Andrew tests theories about chemtrails, cloud seeding, space lasers, and government weather weapons.

title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups
description:
S01 E01 — Mind-Controlled Assassin
A failed assassination unleashes claims of a mind-controlled gunman; Andrew investigates the CIA's legacy of MK-Ultra, and stages an experiment with mentalist Max Major.

title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups
description:
S01 E04 — The Great COVID Conspiracy
Andrew probes COVID-19's origin from all angles; using intelligence tradecraft, expert interviews, and real-world analysis, he investigates natural spillover, lab-related, and accidental release theories, and what he uncovers is shocking.

title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups
description:
S01 E06 — Invisible Weapon of War
Andrew tests a disturbing theory: is a secret, directed-energy weapon used in Venezuela the smoking gun behind unexplained attacks on U.S. government officials overseas?

title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups
description:
S01 E08 — Secrets of the Drug War
Going deeper while investigating the modern war on drugs, testing theories around the question: if the war is real, why are drug cartels more wealthy and powerful than ever?

title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups
description:
S01 E02 — Jersey Drone Panic
When a swarm of craft floods New Jersey's skies, panic erupts online; Andrew digs into every conspiracy theory, interviewing eyewitnesses and testing cutting-edge drone tech, until he uncovers the truth behind the incident.

title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups
description:
S01 E07 — Programmed by AI
Using a real-world test and expert insights, Andrew asks a frightening question; have we already crossed the dangerous point of no return where artificial intelligence is capable of independently manipulating our reality without us knowing it?

title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups
description:
S01 E05 — Mysterious Death of Jeffrey Epstein
Andrew investigates what really happened to Jeffrey Epstein; by reconstructing the crime scene using insider insights, expert analysis and a full replica of his jail cell, he tests whether the evidence points to suicide, murder or something darker.

The Raneys help the Russells, who are struggling on a failing homestead in the forests of Pennsylvania; the family faces a food shortage, with no hunting skills and a cabin on the brink of collapse.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S20 E19 — Nothin' but Mammals
In the Season 20 finale, four boats race to beat closing canneries as conditions intensify on the water; Sig suffers a major outage with hours to port; Jake uses his only gear to back out of trouble; John doubles down on orcas.

title: Homestead Rescue
description:
S11 E09 — All My Stresses Live in Texas
A family of recent transplants that is longing for ranch life in central Texas finds itself on one of the most unsuitable homesteads the Raneys have seen yet; to save them, the Raneys must execute a total homestead makeover.

title: Homestead Rescue
description:
S12 E05 — Heartland Heartache
Farmsteaders are on the verge of losing the legacy of their late father; the Raneys must quickly give them an off-grid masterclass and help them complete one of the unique rescues.

title: Homestead Rescue
description:
S10 E06 — Kentucky Calamity
A Kentucky homestead, built in the historical remnants of an old mining town, faces biblical flooding; Marty revives the original barn, Matt devises a livestock escape pod and Misty conceives her first floating greenhouse.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description:
S04 E09 — Monsoon Millions
Under the threat of severe thunderstorms and floods during monsoon season in Arizona, Freddy and Juan must not only fix the group of friends' operation, but also race to recover enough gold to stop the investor from pulling out.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description:
S04 E08 — Zeroes to Golden Heroes
An Oregon miner calls Freddy and Juan to help save his mine to pass it on to his greenhorn son; they give the son some valuable know-how, but discover the property has been completely mined out; an all-out prospecting hunt to save their dream.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description:
S03 E09 — Home Is Where the Gold Is
A family sells everything to purchase a 150-acre gold-rich property to mine and homestead; as their families grow, their gold production does not; shutdowns and broken equipment send Freddy and Juan's plans off track, forcing all-new ingenuity.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E01 — Living Life on the Edge
A damaged hauler carrying U.S. mail through Colorado shuts down I-70; hurricane-force winds in Wyoming leave a semi skewered; a jackknife on an icy overpass in Utah has the recovery crew at odds.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S17 E01 — The Most Gold Wins
Parker and Tony set 13,000-ounce gold totals, sparking a battle to see who can mine the most and reigniting an old feud; Rick faces health issues and an uncertain future; a new player enters the Klondike fray.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S17 E02 — A Midas Mess
Tony's crew sinks a bulldozer and two trucks in the Midas Cut while his grandson flirts with a rock truck driver; Parker pushes to get his second wash plant running; Buzz struggles to assemble a new plant.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S17 E03 — Diagnosing Rick
Rick receives a life-altering diagnosis; Greenhorns push Tony to his breaking point; Parker fires up a third plant and gets surprising gold results.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E02 — The Tunnel of Chaos
The I-70 Eisenhower Tunnel closes in both directions as a 78-vehicle pileup creates mass chaos; mountain recovery and stauffer's towing battle high winds and slick roads to clear wreckage and keep major highways moving.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description:
S06 E02 — Last Stand in Silver City
Hoping to right the mining mistakes of his father, a rookie Idaho miner closes his failing 30-year-old auto business to chase gold in the remote Idaho Hills.

A rockabilly musician's pink Cadillac; a small tugboat; historic baseball memorabilia.

description:

The family visits some East Coast friends: The New York Farm Girls. Farming isn't easy when the cows don't want to cooperate. The dairy farm crowns a new winner for Fastest Milker and Farmer Grayce shows us how millennials get it done.

Heavy Hitters Qualifying Group B Day Two from Marion County, FL. Anglers compete to advance as well as for the $10,000 Big Bass Bonus.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E03 — Mine and Shine
Josh invests money he doesn't yet have to build a still site that doubles as a gold mine; Mark enlists Amanda and Kelly to distill liquor from surplus soybeans to prove Digger wrong.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S04 E08 — Tomato, Tomate
Officers discover a lethal load in the back seat of a car; 70-year-old sisters are caught trying to smuggle pain pills; a woman and son with fake visas attempt to cross into the US; officers assist a surgeon whose vehicle will only drive in reverse.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S04 E10 — Don't Get Cocky
Two men are caught attempting to smuggle a rooster for cockfighting; officers find millions of dollars of counterfeit goods; a woman flees after dumping drugs on the bridge; an illicit load is found hidden in the axles of a lowboy trailer.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S04 E04 — The Kids Aren't Alright
Officers find a concealed load in the side panels of a truck; Hundreds of gun parts headed for Mexico are intercepted; A man who claims to have been kidnapped by a drug cartel seeks asylum in the US; A traveler arrives with an unusual cut of meat.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S04 E12 — Florida or Bust
A concealed shipment is hidden in the fifth wheel of a tractor-trailer; officers searching a courier's van find a lethal cache; an unlikely source sets off the radiation detector; a young woman is detained for a warrant she didn't know she had.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S04 E09 — Magazines in Socks
Officers make a massive seizure after searching a spicy load; a former teacher is surprised to find she has an arrest warrant; two men are caught with gun parts in their luggage; a traveler's cargo is scrutinized when crossing liquor into the U.S.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
No Gun Intended
Drug cartels are estimated to control up to one-third of Mexico's territory — there's an insatiable demand for guns and ammo south of the border, and a ready supply of Americans willing to smuggle them. CBP is ready to intercept.

title: Expedition Files
description:
S03 E08 — History Got It Wrong
Was the Hindenburg truly destroyed by accident or by sabotage?; could the famous Patterson-Gimlin Bigfoot footage hold clues that only modern analysis can define?; what really happened when 50,000 Persian soldiers disappeared in 524 B.C.?

title: Expedition Files
description:
S03 E04 — Lost Treasures
What really became of Königsberg Castle's Amber Room, stolen by the Nazis? Could a lost hard drive in a British landfill hold millions in Bitcoin? Did King Solomon's legendary mines ever exist?

title: Expedition Files
description:
S04 E08 — Who Done It?
Josh uncovers the culprits behind three of history's most baffling mysteries -- the suspected murder of explorer Meriwether Lewis, a possible U.N. plot around Dag Hammarskjöld's 1961 plane crash and the vanishing of New York judge Joseph Crater.

title: Expedition Files
description:
S04 E11 — The Supernatural
Josh Gates explores the supernatural, from Nikola Tesla's mysterious Death Ray to an encoded message from a Sicilian nun believed to be of demonic origin; scientists uncover the real explanation behind the Oracle of Delphi's prophetic visions.

title: Expedition X
description:
S11 E01 — Secrets of Vulture City
Heather and Jack Osbourne investigate Vulture City, Ariz., a ghost town with Gold Rush-era spirits; they explore possible ancient, darker forces.

title: Expedition X
description:
S09 E05 — Werewolves of France
Heather and Phil travel to the French countryside to track down werewolves that have terrorized the locals for centuries; as their investigation deepens, they must figure out if this beast is supernatural or an elusive wolf undiscovered by man.

title: Expedition X
description:
S12 E04 — Ghosts of Guam
Guam's brutal wartime past is said to have left more than scars upon its shores; after reports of hostile spirits and unexplained encounters, Phil and Heather venture from haunted battlefields into the island's remote jungle in search of answers.

title: Expedition X
description:
